data.body:
[P2] Require tests for the score-boundary behavior

The added tests reject an oversized positive score but never exercise a negative score or an overshoot within `SCORE_TOLERANCE`. Removing the lower-bound check or setting the tolerance to zero therefore leaves their assertions unchanged, while changing whether replies fail or become checkpointed endpoint scores. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4; the tolerance is also an uncovered decision under rule 7. Return to the design phase and either simplify to strict bounds or document the tolerance with tests that require both boundary checks and the tolerated cases.
